categories.main_business_segments: Jeil Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of pharmaceutical products, focusing on finished drugs. The company also engages in contract manufacturing and research and development through its subsidiary Onconic Therapeutics, which specializes in new drug development. Other business activities include licensing and technology transfer agreements related to pharmaceuticals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced pharmaceutical manufacturing technologies including synthesis of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), formulation development for tablets, capsules, and injectables, and contract manufacturing. R&D efforts focus on innovative drug discovery, preclinical and clinical development, and process optimization. The company also employs patented stem cell technologies and dual-target cancer therapies through its subsidiary.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jeil Pharmaceutical serves hospitals, clinics, and pharmacies primarily within South Korea, with a small portion of sales from exports. Its products target various therapeutic areas including gastroenterology, cardiology, oncology, neurology, and infectious diseases. The company also licenses out technologies and products globally, including markets in China and worldwide through partnerships.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with manufacturing facilities located in Yongin. It has global licensing agreements and exports products internationally, including China and other worldwide markets. Its subsidiary Onconic Therapeutics also pursues global clinical development and commercialization.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jeil Pharmaceutical operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on drug formulation, manufacturing, and sales. It sources raw materials and APIs from global suppliers and engages in contract manufacturing and licensing. The company also invests in upstream R&D for new drug discovery through its research centers and subsidiary.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in new drug development and improvement of existing drugs, investing heavily in R&D with a focus on innovative and improved pharmaceuticals. It maintains dedicated research divisions for clinical development, formulation technology, and synthesis. Strategic partnerships and licensing agreements support global expansion and pipeline diversification, with ongoing clinical trials in oncology, diabetes, and other therapeutic areas.
categories.revenue_model: Jeil Pharmaceutical generates revenue primarily through the sale of pharmaceutical products domestically and internationally. Additional revenue streams include contract manufacturing services, licensing fees, milestone payments, and royalties from technology transfers and partnerships. The company also earns income from clinical trial collaborations and government research grants.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major Korean pharmaceutical firms such as Yuhan Corporation, Chong Kun Dang, Green Cross, Daewoong Pharmaceutical, and Hanmi Pharmaceutical. Jeil Pharmaceutical holds a mid-tier market position with steady growth and a focus on specialty and innovative drugs. It differentiates through R&D capabilities and strategic licensing partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Jeil Pharmaceutical reported consolidated revenues of approximately KRW 726 billion with a net income of KRW 5.2 billion, showing slight growth compared to the previous year. The company maintains stable financial health with total assets around KRW 487 billion and a debt-to-equity ratio of about 210%. R&D expenses represent around 6.7% of sales, indicating sustained investment in innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jeil Pharmaceutical emphasizes its strong R&D capabilities, innovative drug pipeline, and high-quality manufacturing standards as key differentiators. The company offers a diverse portfolio of specialty pharmaceuticals addressing unmet medical needs and leverages strategic licensing to access advanced technologies. Its commitment to compliance with stringent regulatory standards and customer-focused marketing enhances its competitive edge.
